description: Fires when the opponent threatens to win in column 0, the leftmost column: above all when they have three stones stacked vertically at the top of column 0 with the cell above empty (activation 10-40, nearly always fires). It fires weakly when column 0's landing cell is my only must-block for a horizontal or diagonal four. It does not fire on my own vertical three, a blocked three, two stacked stones, or vertical threes in other columns (mostly).
effect: Pushes the model's move toward column 0 (the block): forcing it high on a quiet opening moves about +0.85 probability to column 0; zeroing it on a column-0 vertical threat moves about 0.20 from column 0 to column 3. On positions already decided it changes nothing.
notes: Tried: col-0 vertical O-three only (F1 0.485, P 0.98, R 0.32); plus any col-0 must-block (0.503); plus vertical threes in any column (0.355, precision collapsed); vertical three in col 0 or the only must-block in col 0 (0.517, best). act minimal pairs: 2,0,6,0,5,0 gives 36; with only two stacked -0.3; capped by my stone 0.07; my own three -1.35; still fires 25 when the last move is elsewhere. Weak firing (0.76-2, more than half of all firing) is varied and not captured. Simulation share is nan because the perfect reader's recovery is negative. Synthesis peaked at 38.7, below the dev max of 40.8.
